// meterId | extend extendingToCheck = 'checkMeterIdsAndSiteCounts';// | where meterId in ('eafa2a7c-2139-4c50-8a30-8db3f248a467','e670c793-c1d4-4aaa-8a0b-7c311f83005f','0c688e9e-3d47-469e-802d-259e05311d2c','445c828f-77a3-4c27-a5be-fed24735a72c');
// 
    let sites = silverCommDataSite
    | where siteId in (testsite) or siteId in (meterId|project siteId) 
        | join kind = inner meterId on siteId
        // | where sourceTimestamp between (datetime(2025-06-01) .. datetime(2025-06-02))
        // | where sourceTimestamp between (datetime(2025-07-01 02:00:00.0000000) .. datetime(2025-07-01 04:00:00.0000000))
         | where sourceTimestamp between (datetime_add('minute',-30,startTime)  .. datetime_add('minute',45,endTime))
         | join kind=leftanti (recordsToRemove) on siteId, sourceTimestamp
        //| where sourceTimestamp between (datetime(2025-06-30) .. datetime(2025-07-01))
        // | where sourceTimestamp between (datetime(2025-07-01) .. datetime(2025-07-02))
        | extend normalizedTimestamp = bin(sourceTimestamp, 15m)//,old_normalizedTimestamp = bin(sourceTimestamp + 15m - 1m, 15m)
        | extend local_normalizedts = bin((sourceTimestamp - 7h), 15m)//, old_local_normalizedts = bin((sourceTimestamp - 7h) + 15m - 1m, 15m)
        | extend local_sourceTimestamp = sourceTimestamp - 7h
        | project siteId,meterId, oem,sourceTimestamp, normalizedTimestamp, local_normalizedts, local_sourceTimestamp, battery_200_IncWhImp, battery_200_IncWhExp//,old_normalizedTimestamp,old_local_normalizedts
        | order by siteId, sourceTimestamp
    ; 
    // sites | where siteId in(400023445);
    // sites | where siteId == testsite;
    // sites | distinct siteId | extend extendingToCheck = 'checkDistinctSiteCount';
    // sites | extend extendingToCheck = '100k thisIsTelemetry' | project-reorder extendingToCheck | limit 100000;
    // let timeModes = sites
    //     | order by siteId, sourceTimestamp | serialize 
    //     | extend delay = datetime_diff('minute',iif(prev(siteId,1)==siteId, prev(sourceTimestamp,1), datetime(null)),sourceTimestamp)
    //     | summarize count() by siteId, delay
    //     | summarize arg_max(count_,*) by siteId
    //     | project siteId, delay
    // ;
    //added for aug solaredge case
    let oems = materialize(
        sites | distinct siteId, oem
    )
    ;
    let new_bin_base_join = 
        meterId
        | extend dummy = 1
        | join kind = fullouter (allBins | extend dummy = 1) on dummy
        | project-away dummy, dummy1
        | join kind = leftouter (sites) on $left.bin_base == $right.normalizedTimestamp and siteId and meterId
        | project-away siteId1, meterId1
        // | join kind = leftouter (timeModes) on siteId
        | order by siteId, meterId, bin_base asc
        | serialize
        | extend energy_consumed_kwh = battery_200_IncWhImp/1000
            ,energy_generated_kwh = battery_200_IncWhExp/1000
        // | extend energy_consumed_kwh = iff(delay == 30, iff(isempty(battery_200_IncWhImp) and next( siteId) == siteId,next(battery_200_IncWhImp),battery_200_IncWhImp)/2, battery_200_IncWhImp)/1000
            // ,energy_generated_kwh = iff(delay == 30, iff(isempty(battery_200_IncWhExp) and next( siteId) == siteId,next(battery_200_IncWhExp),battery_200_IncWhExp)/2, battery_200_IncWhExp)/1000
        | extend energy_net_kwh = energy_consumed_kwh - energy_generated_kwh
        | extend local_bin = bin_base - 7h
        | project meter_id = meterId, 
                  siteId, oem, 
                  sourceTimestamp,
                  local_interval_start_time = coalesce(local_normalizedts, local_bin),
                  local_interval_end_time = coalesce(local_normalizedts + 15m, local_bin + 15m),
                  bin_base,
                //   delay,
                  interval_start_time_utc = bin_base,
                  interval_end_time_utc = bin_base + 15m,
                  battery_200_IncWhImp,battery_200_IncWhExp,
                  energy_net_kwh,
                  energy_consumed_kwh, 
                  energy_generated_kwh, 
                  final = 'true', 
                  region = 'CA'
        //aug adjustment for solar edge
        | extend interval_start_time_utc = iif(siteId in (oems | where oem == 'solaredge' | project siteId), interval_start_time_utc - 15m, interval_start_time_utc)
            ,interval_end_time_utc = iif(siteId in (oems | where oem == 'solaredge' | project siteId), interval_end_time_utc - 15m, interval_end_time_utc)
    ;
    // new_bin_base_join | extend extendingToCheck = 'what joining looks like for 100k rows' | order by siteId, interval_start_time_utc asc, sourceTimestamp asc | project-reorder extendingToCheck| limit 100000;
    // new_bin_base_join | summarize count() by bin_base, siteId | extend extendingToCheck = 'same row count as calendar base * sites';
    // new_bin_base_join | distinct siteId, oem | where siteId in (new_bin_base_join | summarize count_distinct(oem) by siteId | where count_distinct_oem > 1);
    // new_bin_base_join | where meter_id =='f9e463b0-3e50-4abe-9b83-2086403ad102';// //== '30296bd6-499d-43b0-a137-38fd3f661694'; //found single discharge value not account since charge value was negative
    new_bin_base_join
    | summarize energy_net_kwh = sum(energy_net_kwh), energy_consumed_kwh = sum(energy_consumed_kwh), energy_generated_kwh = sum(energy_generated_kwh)
        ,energy_net_kwh_nulls = iif(countif(isnotnull(energy_net_kwh)) == 0, real(null), sum(energy_net_kwh))
        ,energy_consumed_kwh_nulls = iif(countif(isnotnull(energy_consumed_kwh)) == 0, real(null), sum(energy_consumed_kwh))
        ,energy_generated_kwh_nulls = iif(countif(isnotnull(energy_generated_kwh)) == 0, real(null), sum(energy_generated_kwh))
        by meter_id, interval_start_time_utc, interval_end_time_utc, final, region//, siteId, oem
    | project meter_id, 
            //   siteId, oem, 
                interval_start_time_utc = strcat(format_datetime(interval_start_time_utc, "yyyy-MM-dd"), "T", format_datetime(interval_start_time_utc, "HH:mm:ss.ffff"), "Z"),
                interval_end_time_utc = strcat(format_datetime(interval_end_time_utc, "yyyy-MM-dd"), "T", format_datetime( interval_end_time_utc, "HH:mm:ss.ffff"), "Z"),
            //   energy_net_kwh = coalesce(tostring(round(energy_net_kwh,3)), "Null"),
                energy_net_kwh = coalesce(tostring(round(energy_net_kwh_nulls,3)), "Null"),
                energy_consumed_kwh = coalesce(tostring(round(energy_consumed_kwh_nulls,3)), "Null"),
                energy_generated_kwh = coalesce(tostring(round(energy_generated_kwh_nulls,3)), "Null"),
            //   energy_consumed_kwh = coalesce(tostring(round(energy_consumed_kwh,3)), "Null"), 
            //   energy_generated_kwh = coalesce(tostring(round(energy_generated_kwh,3)), "Null"), 
                final = 'true', 
                region = 'CA'
    | order by interval_start_time_utc asc, meter_id asc //| where meter_id =='f9e463b0-3e50-4abe-9b83-2086403ad102'
// theoutputdata
| where interval_start_time_utc != 'TZ' and interval_start_time_utc != strcat(format_datetime(endTime, "yyyy-MM-dd"), "T", format_datetime( endTime, "HH:mm:ss.ffff"), "Z")
//addition for aug solar edge change
and interval_end_time_utc != strcat(format_datetime(startTime, "yyyy-MM-dd"), "T", format_datetime( startTime, "HH:mm:ss.ffff"), "Z")
